testcase.name: Scenario: Apply and restore wheel opacity: tmp/obk-wheel-3945-source/features/application/viewport-navigation-wheel/viewport-navigation-wheel.feature:127:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Apply and restore wheel opacity ✔ Given the full navigation wheel is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And its wheel opacity preference is 50% ✔ When the user opens the wheel options and chooses 90% wheel opacity ✔ And the user clicks OK ✔ Then the options dialog closes and the wheel remains visible ✔ When the user reopens the wheel options ✔ Then the wheel opacity field displays 90% ✔ When the user chooses 50% wheel opacity and clicks OK ✔ Then the options dialog closes and the wheel remains visible ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the wheel closes and the status area displays Ready
